# Hi, I'm Shah Faisal Wani 👋
AI engineer in Bangkok. I build real-time voice and speech AI, and the full stack apps around it.

- 🔭 **Now:** Research Engineer at SCB DataX, working on real-time Thai speech recognition and the evaluation and monitoring for a bank's voice AI agent.
- 🕌 **Building:** [Iqra AI](https://iqra-teacher.vercel.app), a voice tutor that listens to your Quran recitation and tells you exactly which sound you got wrong, from the Arabic alphabet to tajweed and the surahs of Juz Amma. I built it solo, from the pronunciation model to the web app and live voice sessions.
- 📄 **Paper:** co-author of [Typhoon ASR Streaming](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14991), real-time Thai speech recognition ([code](https://github.com/warit-s/typhoon-asr-streaming)).
- 🧩 **Open source:** [ComfyUI-Mojen-Nodeset](https://github.com/ShahFaisalWani/ComfyUI-Mojen-Nodeset), image nodes on the Comfy Registry.
- 🛠️ **Also:** co-founder of Mojen.ai and the engineer behind [alwanitravel.com](https://www.alwanitravel.com).
- 📫 [shahfaisalwani14@gmail.com](mailto:shahfaisalwani14@gmail.com) · [faisalwani.dev](https://faisalwani.dev)
